name: Stygia
title: Stygia: The Fifth Layer
description: Stygia is the fifth layer of the Nine Hells, a frozen layer of cold and ice with a vast, dark sea beneath the glaciers.
wiki: Stygia is a realm of eternal frost where Prince Levistus is imprisoned in a colossal block of ice. The River Styx flows through this layer, becoming a frozen torrent of ice and slush.
